summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed Form 8-K under Items 1.01 and 8.01 to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten public offering of $600M 5.250% senior notes due 2036 and $1.4B 5.950% senior notes due 2056. The offering was made under an effective shelf registration statement with expected close on June 9, 2026. This represents a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, activist, spin-off, or restructuring activity. Watch for interest rate movements and the company's use of proceeds, but no event-driven opportunity is present.
